heading: ### Placing a feature into a relation table
proposed: Known issue: a DataField, DataColumn or RelationColumn that `fill` or `update <table> --add feature` creates gets an explicit `label` at creation. The label is the member name with only its first letter capitalized (for example `TotalLabel`, not `Total Label`), and the generated table shows that value as the column header. The generator splits words only when `label` is unset, so the raw member name reaches the UI. Workaround: set a readable header on every such column with `update <column-fqn> --set label=<Header text>` (for example `<TO>::<TO>_Table::<member>`), including columns added after `fill`, and check it with `query esm DataColumn --select label`.

heading: ### Known Issues of the Generated DAO
proposed: - **A single-valued reference loaded through a sub-select runs one statement per parent row.** When the sub-select is not joined directly to the root query, or has a limit, the runtime loads the reference with one SQL statement per parent row, so the time grows with the number of parent rows. Derived members in the reference's mask (their getter expressions) are evaluated inside each of those statements. Workaround: map the referenced entity with a smaller transfer object that leaves out the derived members the page does not show, or compute the value on the referenced entity once. No pg_stat trace was captured; the per-row loop is the code path that matches the growth reported.
